published_title: From Hoth, With Love (modified with help from other users)...
description:
"That's it. The Rebels are there.

That is the system. And I'm sure Skywalker is with them. Set your course for the Hoth system. General Veers, prepare you men."
strategy:
Strategy:

Turn 1: Use You May Start Your Landing to get the 3rd Marker (Defensive Perimeter). While you are cruising through your Reserve Deck, check to see if DVDLOTS and Blizzard 4 are in there. If they are in there then use the objective to upload Blizzard 4. Immediatly download and play for free DVDLOTS. Otherwise do this next turn when they should have recirculated into your reserve. Don't forget to pay the maintanace cost!

Turn 2:

Upload Blizzard 1 using the objective. Deploy it to the fifth marker. Move Vader on board.

Turn 3:

Upload the AT-AT Cannon (V). Deploy it on Blizzard 1 (V). Move Blizzard 1 to the third marker.

Turn 4:

Upload the Electro-Rangefinder if you are not confident that you can blow away the generator right now (ie Vader somehow got killed or you have lost control of some Hoth Sites). Otherwise do Turn 5's stuff this turn.

Turn 5:

Upload Target the Main Generator. Attempt to blow away the generator. You have a total of 10 before destiny is drawn. So the generator should be toast and the objective should be flipped.

This shouldn't really take five turns since you should be able to blow up the generator in turn 4 and some of those cards are bound to be drawn into hand making it not necessary to upload one each turn.

Basically, after its flipped just spread out over Hoth, use your Walker Garrisons twice during the game wisely for big drains and wait for them to come to you.

Notes: I dumped the troopers and added some more space as well as the weather stuff. The weather stuff should clean up any ground that gets away from the walkers.

I have considered adding a Maul to this deck, but that would cancel Imperial Domination (V). That card seems really powerful in that it can retrieve an Imperial in every battle that I start. Zuckuss would also cancel this effect. As soon as I get Darth Vader I will virtualize him and swap him into this deck. I will also swap in Fel and his ship once I acquire those in place of DS-61-4 and Black 4.

I am a little concerned about my pre-flip activation, but I can't think of any way to add more sites that I can pull without using Location, Location, Location (V) which would mess up my starting trio.

Somebody commented that Kir Kanos would not be good with Imperial Domination (V). I don't understand why.

Let me know what else I should do with this deck. Thanks!
